purpose: Close the S5 reproducibility gap. The recorded audit command previously carried a literal '<audit-prompt>' placeholder, so the packet named no artifact and the invocation could not be reproduced. These are the recovered exact prompt bytes, bound to the sessions that consumed them.

recovery.session_directory_cwd_note: The transcript directory name url-encodes the working directory the runner was invoked in. It decodes to the same task-run directory the prompts were recovered from, independently corroborating that these sessions ran from this run.

wrapper_difference.note: The recorded sha256 of each artifact is the sha256 of the UNWRAPPED tracked file. No hash is asserted over the wrapped transcript form, and the tracked file is not claimed to be byte-identical to the transcript record — it is claimed to occur verbatim inside it, offset by this constant wrapper. Verified identical on both sessions.
